help:
usage: gnd exp init [-h] --out OUT
                    [--kind {codegen,analysis,roundtrip,data-driven,work}]
                    [--title TITLE] [--question ID=TEXT] [--covers ENTRY]
                    [--session-contract PATH]
                    id

Create <out>/<ID>/SPEC.md declaring the questions this experiment will have to
answer. ID must match ^EXP-\d{3}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$ because the id IS the
directory name, and every write goes through the shipped traversal guard. An
existing experiment directory is REFUSED, never overwritten, and there is
deliberately no --force: an experiment directory holds recorded conclusions
and evidence. Exits 0 when the spec is written, 3 when the requested
declaration is not a valid ExperimentSpec, 11 when the experiment directory
already exists (nothing was written), 64 on usage errors including a malformed
ID or a --question that is not ID=TEXT, 74 when the output path is refused by
the guard or is unwritable.

positional arguments:
  id                    the experiment id, e.g. EXP-001-codegen-drift

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             directory the experiment directory is created in
  --kind {codegen,analysis,roundtrip,data-driven,work}
                        the closed experiment kind (default: codegen)
  --title TITLE         one line saying what this experiment is for
  --question ID=TEXT    a declared question; repeatable. Every id must be
                        answered to close.
  --covers ENTRY        compact JSON model-element cover with exactly one of
                        operation, constraint, fact_type, or derivation (which
                        addresses derivation:<id>); repeatable
  --session-contract PATH
                        contract inspected only to establish the work tests-
                        only covers exemption
